title: Compactification-independent finite-level direct image
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $K_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism. Fix a prime $\ell$, write
$\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and require that its image in $K_0$ is invertible.
Choose a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and
put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use finite-torsion coefficients
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] and the compact-support candidate
[def-weil-compact-support-candidate]. Choose an object
$c=(j,\bar f)\in\operatorname{Comp}(f)$ in the compactification category
[def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and define

$$
 Rf_{!,n}=Rf_{!,n}^{c}=R\bar f_{*,n}\,j_!:
 D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})
 \longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n}),
$$

the functor of [def-weil-compact-support-candidate] attached to $c$, between the
derived categories of $A_{E,n}$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], composed from the derived direct image
[def-weil-derived-direct-image] $R\bar f_{*,n}$ and the extension by zero
[def-weil-extension-by-zero] $j_!$. Its
independence of the chosen compactification, and every other property
asserted of it in this blueprint, are asserted on the subcategory $\mathcal
D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(X,A_{E,n})$ of that definition [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory], namely on the complexes
that come from the etale site with an etale-origin witness
[def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]; there the
superscript is dropped. For a refinement $u:c_1\to c_2$, use the natural
comparison isomorphism $Rf_{!,n}^{c_1}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{!,n}^{c_2}$
induced by proper composition and extension by zero
[def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism]. Require these
comparisons to be the identity for identity refinements and transitive under
composition. The independence of the resulting functor from the chosen object
$c$, and the cocycle condition for the comparisons through a common
refinement, are the compactification-coherence proposition
[prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]; that $Rf_{!,n}$
is a triangulated functor is
[lem-compact-support-direct-image-triangulated].

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (order 1486; the slopmaster2 blueprint has no file for this node). The text is kept, with bracket citations inserted so that every notion is a statement dependency: the coefficient ring A_{E,n} (def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension), the derived categories D(X_proet, A) (def-weil-pbc-proetale-site), the derived direct image and extension by zero out of which the candidate R\bar f_{*,n} j_! is composed (def-weil-derived-direct-image, def-weil-extension-by-zero), the subcategory D^+_et(X, A) of complexes with an etale-origin witness (new node def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory, which the blueprint only describes in passing inside def-weil-compact-support-candidate), and the comparison isomorphism along a refinement 'induced by proper composition and extension by zero' (new node def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism, the composite of lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition with the inverse of lem-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison-proetale, as prop-compactification-coherence-detailed states and proves it). prop-compactification-coherence-detailed stays a statement dependency since the definition relies on it for the independence of c; lem-compact-support-direct-image-triangulated remains a pointer (cut 2026-10-09). Both new nodes were searched in Mathlib (small pro-etale site exists, nothing else does) and are unsplit. Noted for the lead: def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility is stated for the finite-field datum (ell != p) while this node allows any field K_0 with ell invertible; the DAG has two parallel definitions of Rf_* and of j_! on the pro-etale site (smooth-purity chapter vs proper-base-change chapter) used interchangeably; 'Require these comparisons to be the identity ... and transitive' states properties proved in the coherence proposition, not data of the definition. The source repository's Lean has AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (the functor of this node for the chosen compactification, no sorry) and, on the etale site only, the comparison along a refinement with a cartesian square whose isomorphism property is a sorry.
